nodes.title: Product Manager - Surgical Equipments
nodes.location: D2-01-01, Pusat Perdagangan Dana 1, Jalan 1A/46, Petaling Jaya
nodes.description:
Join a high-performing and collaborative sales team at Syno Medical, where you’ll play a pivotal role in advancing minimally invasive surgical solutions that make a real difference in patient outcomes. Our diverse portfolio supports a wide range of specialties, including General, Colorectal, Gynecologic, Obstetrics, Urology, Upper GI, and Cardio, which allows you to work at the forefront of surgical innovation within operating rooms and hospital environments.

As a Sales Leader, you will inspire and guide a team of driven professionals, equipping them with the strategic selling skills and clinical expertise needed to engage confidently with surgeons, specialists, and key decision-makers. You won’t just manage performance—you’ll elevate it, fostering a culture of accountability, growth, and excellence.

Entry-level hires may start from RM 3,000 per month.
nodes.requirements:
• Bachelor’s degree in Biomedical Science, Life Sciences, Business, or a related field
  • Minimum 4–7 years of sales experience in medical devices and reusable surgical equipment
  • Proven track record of achieving or exceeding sales targets, preferably in a leadership role
  • Strong leadership and team management skills with the ability to motivate and develop others
  • Solid clinical knowledge or the ability to quickly learn and confidently communicate in surgical environments
  • Excellent interpersonal, communication, and presentation skills
  • Demonstrated ability to build trust and influence key stakeholders, including surgeons and hospital decision-makers
  • Strong business acumen with strategic thinking and problem-solving capabilities
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and adapt to changing priorities
  • Willingness to travel frequently to hospitals and healthcare facilities within the assigned territory
